enum: Payment is made at the studio
The Requirements section gives the address Unit 3, 9 Sample Lane, Pune 411004 as text with no map, and states that payment is made at the studio with no online payment
The Requirements section lists all five classes with exact day, time, class name and price in rupees
The Requirements section specifies the booking form with the fields name, email, class and preferred date, sent to bookings@flowpilates.example
The Requirements section states that the page must work on phones
